Tuesday/Thursday Morning Ride (Tripower Cycling Club)

Virginia Beach, VA · Road

Tuesday/Thursday Morning Ride (Tripower Cycling Club) is a road group ride in Virginia Beach, VA. It rolls tuesdays and Thursdays at 7:15 am from Harris Teeter, south parking lot. About 42 miles, 18-20+ mph per the club; 20-22 mph capped at 22 per the shop calendar.

For visitors

Park in the south lot. The shop says to try the Saturday or Sunday rides first if you are unsure of the pace.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:15 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 20-22 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @tripowercycling the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday/Thursday Morning Ride (Tripower Cycling Club) group ride

An out-and-back morning road ride of about 40 miles heading south from Harris Teeter into Pungo. The club page says 18-20+ mph; the shop calendar lists 20-22 mph with the pace capped at 22 and calls it a drop ride.
